notes.title: Join us on Discord!
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Enmity: Warfare Community Players,[/b]

We are thrilled to announce that our official Enmity Franchise Discord server is now open for all of you to join. We invite you to become a part of our vibrant community, where you can interact with other players, stay up-to-date on the latest developments, and receive exclusive updates and announcements directly from the development team.

Our Discord server is the perfect place for you to engage with like-minded individuals, discuss strategies and tactics, and team with other players. You'll also have access to our dedicated support team, who will be on hand to answer any questions you may have and provide you with technical assistance when needed.

To join our official Enmity Franchise Discord server, simply click on the following link: https://discord.gg/Evu7pp3BNU and start exploring the different channels available to you.

We'll be regularly hosting events, tournaments, and giveaways. So don't miss out on this amazing opportunity to connect with other players and take your Enmity: Warfare gaming experience to the next level and battle together.

Thank you for your continued support and, we cannot to show you our game!

[b]Best regards,[/b]
The Central South Administration Team (CSAT)
